name: glass-alpha-diagnostic
description: settles whether --atrium-glass-alpha is genuinely pushed from C++ (atrium_browser_window.cc backdrop_glass_alpha_) and, if so, whether an inline-style override on documentElement actually sticks against it. Reads the custom property's own resolved value AND the resolved backgroundColor before and after an override, rather than inferring either from pixel means.

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.row'); if (!r) return 'no-row'; r.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.sbtoggle'); if (!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.expression: (() => { const cs = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement); return JSON.stringify({glassAlphaProp: cs.getPropertyValue('--atrium-glass-alpha').trim(), floorProp: cs.getPropertyValue('--atrium-float-wash-floor').trim(), bg: cs.backgroundColor, inlineGlassAlpha: document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--atrium-glass-alpha')}); })()
